points.description: States that a convolutional layer is present, with kernels (filters) that convolve over the input image. Equivalent wording such as 'convolution layer with filters sliding over the image' earns the mark.

Names at least two of the other layers from the model answer: an activation layer (ReLU), a pooling layer (max or average), or fully connected layer(s) followed by a softmax layer. Equivalent wording earns the mark. Full detail of each layer is not required.

rubric.notes: Full marks for naming the convolutional layer with kernels convolving over the input, and for naming at least two further layer types (activation/ReLU, pooling, fully connected, softmax). Award no marks for a point that is missing, vague (e.g. 'many layers' alone), or incorrect. The model answer is a single sentence, so two points at 1 mark each cover it without splitting ideas.
